profile.Name: Jewel
profile.Personality: Smart and pragmatic. She calls herself a realist rather than a coward, avoids needless fights, and drinks to forget the bar she lost.
profile.Backstory: She ran the Punchy Gar, an outlands bar for weary travelers, until Shek barbarians took it over. She escaped and now seeks work as a cook in the towns of the United Cities.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Casual and wry ('I'm a cook, not a fighter, man!'). She talks fondly of her lost bar and her homemade special sauce.
